paragraphs: 1st Source Corporation, an Indiana corporation incorporated in 1971, is a bank holding company headquartered in South Bend, Indiana that provides, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as "1st Source", the "Company", "we", and "our"), a broad array of financial products and services. 1st Source Bank ("Bank"), its wholly-owned banking subsidiary, offers commercial and consumer banking services, trust and wealth advisory services, and insurance to individual and business clients (through 1st Source Insurance, Inc.) from most of our 78 banking center locations in 19 counties in Indiana and Michigan and Sarasota County in Florida. 1st Source Bank's Specialty Finance Group, with 15 locations nationwide, offers specialized financing services for construction equipment, new and pre-owned private and cargo aircraft, and various vehicle types (cars, trucks, vans) for fleet purposes. While our Specialty Finance lending portfolio is concentrated in certain equipment types, we serve a diverse client base. We are not dependent upon any single industry or client. At December 31, 2025, we had consolidated total assets of $9.06 billion, total loans and leases of $7.05 billion, total deposits of $7.23 billion, and total shareholders' equity of $1.27 billion.

Our principal executive office is located at 100 North Michigan Street, South Bend, Indiana 46601 and our telephone number is (574) 235-2000. Access to our annual report on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and all amendments to those reports is available, free of charge, at www.1stsource.com soon after the material is electronically filed with or furnished to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Information on our website is not incorporated by reference into this Form 10-K or our other public filings. The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC at www.sec.gov.

Business Services — 1st Source Bank provides commercial, small business, agricultural, and real estate loans primarily to privately owned businesses to finance industrial and commercial properties, equipment, inventories and accounts receivable, acquisitions and for general corporate purposes. Other business services include commercial leasing, treasury management services, payment services (including digital and real time/immediate payments), Fedwires, ACH and merchant services, and retirement planning services.

Renewable Energy Financing — 1st Source Bank provides financing for commercial solar projects across the contiguous United States, with a focus in the Northeast and Midwest. We provide construction and permanent loans, and tax equity investments for community solar, commercial and industrial, small utility scale, university, and municipal projects. Project sizes generally range from five megawatts to 20 megawatts.

Consumer Services — 1st Source Bank provides a full range of consumer banking products and services through our banking centers, virtual Branch, client service center, and on-line. Traditional banking services include checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposits, Health Savings Accounts and Individual Retirement Accounts as well as loans, credit cards, mortgages and home equity lines of credit. 1st Source also offers a full line of on-line and mobile banking products. Our Automated Teller Machine network supports our debit and credit card program. Consumers also have the ability to obtain consumer loans, credit cards, real estate mortgage loans and home equity lines of credit in any of our banking centers or on-line. 1st Source also offers insurance products through 1st Source Insurance offices or in our banking centers. We also offer a variety of financial planning (through our network of financial advisors), financial literacy, and other consultative services.

Trust and Wealth Advisory Services — 1st Source Bank provides a wide range of trust, investment, agency, and custodial services for individual, estate and trust, corporate, and not-for-profit clients, as well as employee benefit plans and charitable foundations.

Specialty Finance Group Services — Our Specialty Finance Group provides comprehensive commercial new and pre-owned equipment loan and lease products in four areas: construction equipment; aircraft; auto and light trucks; and medium and heavy duty trucks.

Construction equipment financing includes financing of new and pre-owned equipment (i.e., bulldozers, excavators, cranes, loaders, and asphalt and concrete plants etc.). Construction equipment finance relationships which may include multiple pieces of equipment generally range from $100,000 to $40 million with fixed or variable interest rates and terms of one to ten years.

Aircraft financing consists of financings for new and pre-owned general aviation aircraft (including helicopters) for private and corporate users, select aircraft distributors and dealers, charter operators, cargo carriers, and other aircraft operators. 1st Source Bank also provides selective international aircraft financing, primarily in Mexico and Brazil. Aircraft finance relationships generally range from $500,000 to $30 million with fixed or variable interest rates and terms of one to eleven years.

We offer auto and light truck fleet financing for new and pre-owned vehicles to automobile and light truck rental companies, commercial leasing companies, and a limited number of single unit financing for users of specialty vehicles (step vans, vocational work trucks, motor coaches, shuttle buses and funeral cars). The auto and light truck finance relationships generally range from $100,000 to $60 million with fixed or variable interest rates and terms of one to eight years.

The medium and heavy duty truck division provides new and pre-owned fleet financing for highway tractors, medium duty trucks and trailers to the trucking industry. Medium and heavy duty truck finance relationships generally range from $50,000 to $25 million with fixed or variable interest rates and terms of three to eight years.

The Specialty Finance Group operates through 1st Source Bank and its subsidiaries including: Michigan Transportation Finance Corporation, 1st Source Specialty Finance, Inc., SFG Aircraft, Inc., 1st Source Intermediate Holding, LLC, SFG Commercial Aircraft Leasing, Inc., and SFG Equipment Leasing Corporation I.

1st Source Insurance, Inc. is our insurance agency subsidiary placing property and casualty, individual and group health, and life insurance for individuals and businesses. 1st Source Insurance, Inc. has thirteen offices.
1st Portfolio Management, Inc. owns and manages certain available-for-sale investment securities.

An investment in our common stock is subject to risks inherent to our business. The material risks and uncertainties that we believe affect us are described below. See "Forward Looking Statements" under Item 7 of this report for a discussion of other important factors that can affect our business.

We are subject to credit risks relating to our loan and lease portfolios — Commercial and commercial real estate loans generally involve higher credit risks than residential real estate and consumer loans. Because payments on loans secured by commercial real estate or equipment are often dependent upon the successful operation and management of the underlying assets, repayment of such loans may be influenced to a great extent by conditions in the market or the economy. We seek to mitigate these risks through our underwriting standards. Most commercial and industrial loans are secured by the assets being financed or other business assets; however, some loans may be made on an unsecured basis.

We offer both fixed-rate and adjustable-rate consumer mortgage loans secured by properties, substantially all of which are located in our primary market area. Adjustable-rate mortgage loans help reduce our exposure to changes in interest rates; however, during periods of rising interest rates, the risk of default on adjustable-rate mortgage loans may increase as a result of repricing and the increased payments required from the borrower. Additionally, some residential mortgages are sold into the secondary market and serviced by our principal banking subsidiary, 1st Source Bank.

Consumer loans are primarily all other non-real estate loans to individuals in our regional market area. Consumer loans can entail risk, particularly in the case of loans that are unsecured or secured by rapidly depreciating assets. In these cases, any repossessed collateral may not provide an adequate source of repayment of the outstanding loan balance. The remaining deficiency often does not warrant further substantial collection efforts against the borrower beyond obtaining a deficiency judgment. In addition, consumer loan collections are dependent on the borrower's continuing financial stability, and thus are more likely to be adversely affected by job loss, divorce, illness, or personal bankruptcy.

The 1st Source Specialty Finance Group loan and lease portfolio consists of commercial loans and leases secured by construction and transportation equipment, including aircraft, autos, trucks, and vans.

Our construction and transportation related businesses could be adversely affected by slowdowns in the economy. Clients who rely on the use of assets financed through the Specialty Finance Group to produce income could be negatively affected, and we could experience substantial loan and lease losses. By the nature of the businesses these clients operate in, we could be adversely affected by rapid increases or decreases in fuel costs, terrorist and other potential attacks, and other destabilizing events. These factors could contribute to the deterioration of the quality of our loan and lease portfolio, as they could have a negative impact on the travel and transportation sensitive businesses for which our Specialty Finance Group provides financing.

1st Source Corporation, 一間於印地安那州註冊成立的公司，於1971年成立，為一家銀行控股公司，總部設於印地安那州南本德市，透過其子公司（ collectively referred to as "1st Source", the "Company", "we", and "our" ）提供廣泛的金融產品與服務。1st Source Bank ("Bank"), 其全資擁有之銀行子公司，為個人及企業客戶（透過1st Source Insurance, Inc. 提供保險服務）提供商業與消費銀行服務、信託與財富顧問服務，以及保險服務，服務範圍涵蓋我們在印地安那州與密歇根州19個縣以及佛羅裏達州薩拉索塔縣的78個銀行中心據點。1st Source Bank 的專門金融集團，擁有全國15個據點，為建設機械、新舊私人與貨運飛機以及各種車型（汽車、貨車、貨運車）提供專門的融資服務。雖然我們的專門金融貸款組合集中於某些設備類型，但我們服務的客戶羣體相當多元。我們不依賴任何單一產業或客戶。於2025年12月31日，我們的合併總資產為9.06 十億美元，總貸款與租賃為7.05 十億美元，總存款為7.23 十億美元，總股東權益為1.27 十億美元。
商業服務 — 1st Source Bank提供商業、中小企業、農業與不動產貸款，主要針對私人所有企業，用以資金融資工業與商業不動產、設備、存貨與應收帳款、收購以及一般企業用途。其他商業服務包括商業租賃、財務管理服務、支付服務（包括數位與即時/瞬時支付）、Fedwires、ACH與商家服務，以及退休規劃服務。
可再生能源融資 — 1st Source Bank提供美國連續性州份的商業太陽能專案融資，重點在於東北部與中西部。我們提供建設貸款與永久貸款，以及稅務權益投資，用於社區太陽能、商業與工業、小型電力、大學與地方政府專案。專案規模通常介於五兆瓦至二十兆瓦之間。

消費者服務 — 1st Source Bank透過我們的銀行中心、虛擬分行、客戶服務中心與線上平台，提供完整的消費者銀行產品與服務。傳統銀行服務包括支票帳戶與儲蓄帳戶、存款憑證、健康儲蓄帳戶與個人退休帳戶，以及貸款、信用卡、房貸與房屋貸款。1st Source也提供完整的線上與行動銀行產品。我們的自動提款機網路支援我們的提款卡與信用卡計畫。消費者也可在任何銀行中心或線上取得消費者貸款、信用卡、不動產房貸貸款與房屋貸款。1st Source也透過1st Source Insurance辦事處或銀行中心提供保險產品。我們也提供多種財務規劃（透過我們的財務顧問網路）、財務素養及其他諮詢服務。
信託與財富諮詢服務 — 1st Source Bank為個人、遺產與信託、企業與非營利機構客戶，以及員工福利計畫與慈善基金提供廣泛的信託、投資、代理與保管服務。
專業融資組服務 — 我們的Specialty Finance組提供四個領域的全面商業新舊設備貸款與租賃產品：建設設備；飛機；汽車與輕型貨車；以及中型與重型貨車。
建設設備融資包括新機與二手設備（即推土機、挖土機、起重機、裝載機以及瀝青與混凝土工廠等）的融資。包含多件設備的建設設備融資關係，通常範圍從 100,000 美元至 40 百萬美元，利率為固定或變動，期限為一至十年。
飛機融資業務包含為私人與企業用戶、選定飛機經銷商與經銷商、包機運營商、貨運電信業者及其他飛機運營者提供的新機與二手一般航空飛機（包括直升機）融資。1st Source Bank 亦提供選擇性的國際飛機融資，主要於墨西哥與巴西進行。飛機融資關係通常在 50 萬美元至 3,000 萬美元之間，利率為固定或變動，期限為 1 至 11 年。
我們為汽車與輕型貨車租賃公司、商業租賃公司以及少數專用車輛用戶（如階梯式貨車、職業用途貨車、摩托車旅館、接駁巴士與喪葬車）提供新機與二手車輛的車隊融資。汽車與輕型貨車融資關係通常在 10 萬美元至 6,000 萬美元之間，利率為固定或變動，期限為 1 至 8 年。
中型與重型貨車部門為貨運業提供新機與二手車隊融資，包括高速公路牽引車、中型貨車與拖車。中型與重型貨車融資關係通常在 5 萬美元至 2,500 萬美元之間，利率為固定或變動，期限為 3 至 8 年。

專門融資部門透過 1st Source Bank 及其子公司運作，包括：Michigan Transportation Finance Corporation、1st Source Specialty Finance, Inc.、SFG Aircraft, Inc.、1st Source Intermediate Holding, LLC、SFG Commercial Aircraft Leasing, Inc. 以及 SFG Equipment Leasing Corporation I。
1st Source Insurance, Inc. 為我們的保險代理子公司，為個人與企業提供財產與意外險、個人與團體健康險以及人壽險。1st Source Insurance, Inc. 擁有十三個辦公室。
1st Portfolio Management, Inc. 擁有並管理某些可供出售的投資證券。

paragraphs: 此分析旨在協助您瞭解本公司過去三年各年度之營運成果及過去兩年度之財務狀況。
本報告，包括管理層對財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，包含前瞻性陳述。前瞻性陳述包含有關本公司信念、計畫、目標、目標、期望、預期、假設、估計、意圖及未來表現之陳述，並涉及已知及未知之風險、不確定性及其他因素，這些因素可能超出本公司之控制範圍，並可能導致實際結果、表現或成就與前瞻性陳述所表達或暗示之未來結果、表現或成就有重大差異。
除歷史事實陳述外，所有陳述皆可能為前瞻性陳述。如「相信」、「計畫」、「預期」、「可能」、「假設」、「意圖」、「目標」、「持續」、「維持」、「將」、「應」、「顯示」、「會」、「可能」等詞彙，係用以識別前瞻性陳述，但非唯一識別方式。前瞻性陳述提供目前對未來事件之預期或預測，並非未來表現之保證，亦不應作為代表管理層於任一後續日期之觀點。
本公司所作出之書面或口頭前瞻性陳述，皆應全部依本警示說明書之條件為限。本公司無義務，亦不承諾於本報告日期之後，或於其他作出該等陳述之日期之後，更新、修訂或更正任何前瞻性陳述。本公司已誠實表達其預期、信念及預測，並認為其有合理基礎。然而，本公司不保證其預期、信念或預測將達成或實現。本公司前瞻性陳述所顯示之結果或結果，可能因多種因素而無法實現，包括但不限於以下因素：
•地方、區域、國家及國際經濟狀況及其對本公司、客戶及本公司對該影響之評估的影響。
•非 Performing 資產及核銷金額之水準變動。
•根據相關監管及會計要求之定期審查，未來現金儲備需求之估計變動。
•貿易及貨幣及財政政策與法律，包括聯邦儲備銀行利率政策之影響及變動。
•物價上漲、利率、證券市場以及貨幣波動，包括燃料成本的重大變動。
•政治動盪、戰爭行為或恐怖攻擊，或網路安全威脅。
•傳染性疾病或疫情的擴散。
•新產品與服務的及時開發與接受度，以及他人對這些產品與服務整體價值的認知。
•消費者的支出、貸款與儲蓄習慣的變化。
•我們借款人的財務表現與/或狀況的變化。
投資本公司普通股會面臨與本公司業務相關的風險。我們認為影響我們的主要風險與不確定性已於下文描述。請參閱本報告第 7 項「前瞻性陳述」，以瞭解其他可能影響本公司業務的重要因素。
我們面臨與貸款及租賃組合相關的信用風險 — 商業及商業不動產貸款通常比住宅不動產及消費貸款具有更高的信用風險。因為貸款擔保物為商業不動產或設備的還款通常取決於相關資產的運作與管理成效，因此這些貸款的償還可能受到市場或總體經濟條件的影響。我們透過貸款審核標準來緩解這些風險。大多數商業及工業貸款是以所融資的資產或其他商業資產作為擔保；然而，某些貸款可能以無擔保方式發放。
我們提供固定利率與變動利率的消費房貸貸款，擔保物為不動產，其中絕大多數位於我們的主要市場區域。變動利率房貸貸款有助於降低我們對利率變動的風險；然而，在利率上漲期間，變動利率房貸貸款的違約風險可能增加，這是因為重新定價及借款人所需支付的金額增加所致。此外，部分住宅房貸會出售至次級市場，並由我們的主要銀行子公司 1st Source Bank 進行服務。
消費貸款主要為我們區域市場內個人的其他非不動產貸款。消費貸款可能涉及風險，特別是在貸款為無擔保或以快速折舊資產擔保的情況下。在這些情況下，任何被扣押的擔保品可能無法提供足夠的償還貸款餘額的來源。剩餘的差額通常不值得進一步對借款人進行重大追討，除了取得差額判決外。此外，消費貸款的回收取決於借款人的持續財務穩定性，因此更容易受到失業、離婚、疾病或個人破產等因素的負面影響。
1st Source Specialty Finance Group 的貸款及租賃組合包含以建設及運輸設備（包括飛機、汽車、卡車及貨車）為擔保的商業貸款及租賃。

我們的建設及運輸相關業務可能因經濟放緩而受到不利影響。依賴透過 Specialty Finance Group 融資的資產來產生收入的客戶可能受到負面影響，我們也可能面臨重大貸款及租賃損失。由於這些客戶所經營的業務性質，我們可能因燃料成本的快速增加或減少、恐怖攻擊及其他潛在攻擊，以及其他動盪事件而受到不利影響。這些因素可能導致我們貸款及租賃組合的品質惡化，因為它們可能對我們提供融資的旅遊及運輸敏感型業務產生負面影響。
